reaction: The automatic combination was a useful correction to my guess.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making winged insects was most worthwhile: it connected canopy flight to a useful distinction between insect and vertebrate wings.

leastWorthwhile.text: Repeatedly trying the forest before the lineage was ready became predictable, although the compatibility feedback kept progress moving.

surprise.text: Shore plants led arthropods to insects as a habitat, not as an ancestor; that distinction clarified what the combination represented.

arbitrary.text: Air producing wings felt like a symbolic shortcut rather than an explanation of how flight evolved.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the inhabited forest develops, though I would hope for fewer repeated attempts at the same hotspot.
